reading.body:
The operator of AZ Labs is not published, and the site cannot be reached beyond a street address in Mesa. No power, cooling, or capacity specifications are available. Without published specifications, AZ Labs cannot be placed among data centers that matter to AI infrastructure.

Arizona has 56 mapped facilities and 512 MW of published capacity spread across four sites with disclosed specifications. AZ Labs is unranked in this count because it publishes no figures. The state ranks outside the top tier of US data center capacity, and most of its mapped facilities, like this one, operate without public technical disclosure.

To assess whether this campus matters to AI, you need specifications the operator has not made public: IT load in megawatts, power delivery architecture, and cooling capacity. Without these figures, AZ Labs remains a location on a map rather than a known quantity in the infrastructure that constrains AI scaling.
